prompt: Held keys repeat keyPressed for the same key code. Complete the listener so it reports the current run length, the longest run so far, and the key being repeated.
explanation: Auto-repeat means keyPressed can fire many times for one physical press, so comparing e.getKeyCode() with the previously seen code is what turns a stream of events into a run length. The longest value is tracked with the usual running-maximum pattern: compare after every update, never only at the end. KeyEvent.getKeyText turns a numeric code such as VK_A into readable text without a lookup table of your own.
hints: Store the previous key code in a field and compare it with e.getKeyCode() at the top of keyPressed.
When the code differs, set the stored code to the new one and reset the streak to 1 -- not to 0, because this press counts.
Update the longest value right after changing the streak, using if (streak > longest).
